sheets.question: What was the weighted paired loss difference on the explicitly eligible finite forecast cells?
sheets.fixed_units: The declared issuer/origin/target/version cells and locked models, not the 192 report files.
sheets.estimand: D_A = sum_(c in A) a_c d_c, for a predeclared complete paired set A and fixed nonnegative weights summing to one.
sheets.randomness: No population sampling law is supplied by this description. Numerical forecast/score approximation has a separate error budget.
sheets.generalization: Only the named finite cells and coverage; no new issuer or time-population claim.
sheets.uncertainty_status: A descriptive number is not a confidence bound for unobserved issuers or origins. Missing full-population losses remain unknown.

sheets.question: For the named issuer panel, what expected paired effect applies under a declared law for future or repeated forecast origins?
sheets.fixed_units: Named issuer panel and explicitly defined forecasting policy, calendar, horizon and information rule.
sheets.estimand: Delta_T = E_Q[sum_i w_i d_(i,O)], where Q specifies the joint future-origin/data process and the fitting policy; missingness needs its own scope.
sheets.randomness: Joint time/data process, shared shocks and possibly refitting and forecast randomness; a resample of existing rows does not define Q.
sheets.generalization: Only the named issuers and the stated origin process/regime; no random-issuer interpretation.
requirements: defended origin process and regime assumptions
matched primary theory and sufficient replication
sheets.uncertainty_status: No law, stationarity/mixing assumption, resampling blocks, confidence procedure or sufficient sample is established.

sheets.question: What expected paired effect applies to an explicitly defined future issuer-and-origin population?
sheets.fixed_units: A deployment frame and forecasting/eligibility policy, with currency, presentation, perimeter and accounting-basis strata.
sheets.estimand: Delta_P = E_P[d_(I,O)] for a specified joint issuer/origin law P and a fully specified eligible service or coverage claim.
sheets.randomness: Issuer selection, future origins, outcomes and fitting/prediction randomness according to the declared deployment design.
sheets.generalization: Only the supported frame and sampling/transport assumptions; purposive source coverage supplies no inclusion probabilities.
requirements: population weights fixed before test outcomes
new protected data and matched uncertainty/sample design
sheets.uncertainty_status: The nine purposive issuers do not establish this law, representativeness, exchangeability or a valid population bound.

frozen_e3.main_question: Alternative histories add predictive information beyond one fixed interpretation under the same economics.
frozen_e3.outcome_policy: first_release; later restatements are separately dated sensitivity
frozen_e3.fairness: same as-of information and target; separate training/validation/test; equal stated tuning cap; primary comparator locked before test outcomes
frozen_e3.primary_score: negatively oriented CRPS with finite first moment; smaller is better
frozen_e3.scale: same strictly positive as-of known total assets, fixed before outcome; report unscaled too; missing/nonpositive scale refuses scaled comparison
frozen_e3.secondary_score: energy score only for an admitted joint law with fixed component scales and finite first moments
frozen_e3.unweighted_sets: scoped inclusion, width and decision checks; no invented probabilities
frozen_e3.promotion: defensible uncertainty bound below minus a decision-justified margin plus all validity vetoes; no material business-value claim from zero margin
frozen_e3.fallback: without justified uncertainty, descriptive only and no viable-candidate ranking
